plugins.name: claude-scientific-writer
plugins.description: K-Dense's scientific writing toolkit (papers, grants, posters, clinical reports, document conversion) plus a /scientific-writer-init command. NOTE: this is a BUNDLE — its skills also ship in the focused sci-* and kdense-* plugins. To avoid duplicate skills, install EITHER claude-scientific-writer OR the focused plugins, not both.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Caveman: ultra-compressed communication mode (lite/full/ultra/wenyan). Cuts ~75% of output tokens while keeping technical accuracy. Downstream-patched so terseness reads as value-proportional allocation: a floor for low-value turns, not a cap on high-value ones (see patches/caveman.json).

plugins.name: laconic
plugins.description: Laconic: a value-proportional communication register engine. Ships the 'laconic' register: elliptical but literate, a sharp colleague writing fast. Drop the function words a reader restores for free, keep the logic connectives, notebook symbols where they decode. Compresses the report, never the work behind it. Registers are data files under registers/; drop in a new one to add a voice, no code change.
